source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: سنة من السنين، ما نزلت شتا أبدا.
sentences.en: One year, no rain fell at all.
The land dried up, and the crops died.

sentences.ar: الفلاحين وقفوا حائرين، ما بيعرفوا شو يعملوا.
sentences.en: The farmers stood bewildered, not knowing what to do.
The wells ran dry, and water became scarce.
The people started to fear for the coming year.

sentences.ar: بهديك السنة، الغني والفقير صاروا سوا.
sentences.en: In that year, the rich and the poor became the same.

sentences.ar: رجال غني بالضيعة فتح مخزنه للكل.
sentences.en: A rich man in the village opened his storehouse to everyone.

sentences.ar: قال: اللي عنده، لازم يساعد اللي ما عنده.
sentences.en: He said: whoever has must help whoever doesn't.
He distributed wheat and oil to the poor families.

sentences.ar: الناس كلها وقفت مع بعض بهديك الأيام.
sentences.en: All the people stood together in those days.

sentences.ar: بالآخر، بعد شهور طويلة، نزلت الشتا.
sentences.en: In the end, after long months, the rain fell.

sentences.ar: الناس طلعوا عالشوارع يرقصوا تحت المطر.
sentences.en: The people went out to the streets to dance under the rain.
The land drank, and the crops turned green again.

sentences.ar: تعلمت الضيعة إنه بالشدة، بيبان معدن الناس.
sentences.en: The village learned that in hardship, people's true character shows.
And that cooperation overcomes the hardest of circumstances.
